title: Workers check for overlapping cards and PRs, and start from codegraph
notes: Retro 2026-11-24, both in src/main/skills/work-card-skill.ts. (1) Overlap: openwrt shipped 5 cards on the same scripts and two conflicted after review; new-crm's parallel PRs collided on numbered docs ids 4 times; dashboard #347 and #348 built the same throwaway sweep at once and #347's was thrown away. Before writing code the worker lists the Doing/Review cards and open PRs (board list, gh pr list), and if one covers the same files or area it messages main before going on. For docs ids, a worker takes the next free id only at merge-main time and says so in its report, or main reserves ranges: pick the one that holds. (2) Codegraph: 0 codegraph calls in 6 dashboard workers vs 77 grep/sed/cat calls, one a 25 KB sed of a whole file. Make the first exploration step a literal command, e.g. codegraph explore "<the card's nouns>" run from the main checkout, rather than a line of advice.
